topic: Workload migration comparison: on-premises to cloud

audience.role: IT leads deciding where a workload should run

outcome: Agree to measure one workload and pilot it before any migration decision.
ideas: One IT admin acts out the story as a silent stickman
Define W1 = one workload once, then distinguish instances serving W1 from the workload itself
Compare illustrative variable demand with fixed capacity; CPU alone is not evidence of waste
Cloud capacity can follow demand but has its own costs
Measure, validate, compare total cost, then pilot
Two supplemental pilot-only layout references meet the three-layout design review requirement; the timed output contains only the five architecture scenes.

outline.instruction: Open with the decision the audience faces
Measure demand and operational work without assuming wasted capacity
Show elastic capacity and its honest trade-offs
Show how to build the evidence as a flow
Pilot-only framing design reference; not in timed output
Pilot-only recommendation design reference; not in timed output

sources.title: Illustrative utilisation example (not a measurement)
sources.note: Demand shapes and capacity units are illustrative. Compare local hardware/licences/operations with cloud migration/usage/operations/egress over the same time period. No prices, equality or financial results are claimed.
